description: WebFlux SSE transport bundle for the Pivotable MCP server. Pulls in `pivotable-mcp` (transport-agnostic tool definitions) and `spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webflux` (Spring AI's reactive MCP server starter). A WebFlux Pivotable server module depends on this; a sibling `pivotable-mcp-webmvc` module provides the same wiring for the WebMVC server.
